headline: Bank of the Philippine Islands Expects Energy Projects to Drive Loan Growth
summary: Bank of the Philippine Islands expects power and energy project financing to support corporate loan growth through 2027 amidst softer economic conditions.
why: Sector-specific lending forecasts provide insight into commercial credit demand and banking sector revenue drivers.
